api.name: CZ Solar Warren, LLC
api.description: CZ Solar Warren, LLC is the project company for Cincinnati Zoo Solar, a 28 MW utility-scale solar array on leased Cincinnati Zoo land at Bowyer Farm in Warren County, Ohio. Melink Solar Development originated the project, Soltage acquired the development interest in 2022, and Harrison Street acquired the project from Soltage in September 2022 through its Social Infrastructure Strategy. Public sources do not disclose Harrison Street's specific fund, managed account, upstream holding vehicle, or ownership percentage. The project sells output under two ten-year Calpine Energy Solutions power-purchase agreements, uses Inovateus Solar as EPC, and received tax-equity financing from Nelnet through separate tenant and landlord vehicles; those tax-equity percentages are not treated as direct PortCo ownership stakes. Cincinnati Zoo reported the array operating in 2026, and no subsequent sale or signed pending exit was identified through August 19, 2026.

api.name: Transportation Equipment Network
api.ownershipVehicle: ISQ Open Infrastructure Company LLC—Series II
api.description: Transportation Equipment Network (TEN) is an asset-owning North American commercial-trailer leasing and fleet-services platform serving carriers, shippers and logistics operators. It provides trailer leasing and rentals, maintenance, fleet technology and advisory services, refrigerated-equipment support and storage through an integrated network assembled from Star Leasing, Cooling Concepts, NETS, Commercial Trailer Leasing, TIP Canada and Boston Trailer. Current company disclosures describe approximately 83,000 trailers, about 1,000 employees and nearly 50 locations across the United States and Canada. I Squared began building the platform through ISQ Global Infrastructure Fund II's March 2021 acquisition of employee-owned Star Leasing. TEN became the common trade identity effective July 1, 2024, when Mubadala, QIA and other co-investors invested more than $600 million. Meketa Infrastructure Fund and a separate ISQ Open Infrastructure Company Series II position are also publicly disclosed current interests. Exact post-2024 ownership percentages, securities and vehicles are not fully public; the only precise current percentage found is Series II's 6.29% indirect common-stock interest at March 31, 2026. No later platform sale or signed pending exit was identified through August 19, 2026.

Swift Current Energy acquired the project from Clean Planet Renewable Energy in 2023 while Swift was controlled by IFM-managed funds. IFM reports that Swift completed the sale to Elevate in December 2025, while January 15, 2026 company releases announced the already-completed transfer. Elevate, an ArcLight Energy Partners Fund VII platform, is the current owner and operator, and the project was operating by June 2026. Prospect Power, LLC and tariff successor Lighthouse Prospect Power, LLC are treated as one project identity; Swift and Elevate are sponsor platforms rather than duplicate PortCos.
